hits.title: On-policy distillation as a Backdoor Propagation Channel
hits.abstract_snippet: On-policy distillation (OPD) is emerging as an important paradigm for the post training of large language models, improving student models by leveraging supervision generated online by teacher models. hits.title: Generalization Testing of Grid Foundation Models for Power Flow and Optimal Power Flow
hits.abstract_snippet: There is growing interest in foundation models (FMs) for power grids, particularly for power flow and optimal power flow.
